_readme: Seed claims so the staff review queue and the Strathbites verification have something to work on.

inquiries.claimDescription: That is my violet Galaxy A54. The case has a mountain sticker and the crack is on the top-left. I had lunch at cafe-3 on 20 October around 1pm and left it on the table by the window. My lock screen is a photo of Mt Kenya.

messages.text: Hi Brian, thanks. Please come to the Security Office with your student ID. We'll ask you to unlock the phone.
Thank you, I can come at 4pm today.

inquiries.claimDescription: My student ID in a red lanyard. The holder also has my SACCO card. I paid for lunch at cafe-1 on 21 October and must have dropped it at the counter.
Brown bi-fold wallet with loose stitching. It has my national ID and an Equity card.

messages.text: ID matched. Wallet released on 18 October. Please sign the release book next time you pass by.
